style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

visibleOutcomes.good: A warm cream wide oval balloon with a smooth rounded continuous rim and coherent lower-center tail. The interior remains broad, uninterrupted and quiet so the meal picture is the focus. Rim, internal shading and tail read as one soft form rather than a flat sticker outline. Useful form/structure improvement is welcome within role/registration; the old silhouette is not an aesthetic lock.
visibleOutcomes.reject: A pinched or broken rim/tail, hard angular facets, dead black patches, clipping, extra baked symbols, text, timers, ticks or ornament that competes with the meal.

visibleOutcomes.good: Each of salmon, cucumber and eel uses its exact separately approved canonical full RGBA bitmap, full image UV/aspect and native source palette. At idle/full scale, width is 40 logical pixels (80 physical) centered at [balloonCenterX, balloonCenterY-5]. Original appear scaling and shared alpha are preserved. All three recognizable plate-plus-meal pictures fit comfortably in the blank cream area at 82 logical balloon width.
visibleOutcomes.reject: Stale original foods; recropped, clipped, stretched, warped, regraded or repainted canonical food; whole food picture cut off; meal misidentification; altered center/width or art floating outside the rim.

visibleOutcomes.good: Gentle cream/ivory volume, peach edge depth, controlled white highlights and a warm brown continuous outer rim follow the fixed target. Coherent with approved native heart/smile finish, while preference retains its wider quieter form and no emotive marks. Subtle image detail remains legible and calm at 82 logical pixels.
visibleOutcomes.reject: Harsh plastic glare, muddy gray center, dark crust dominating the small balloon, excessive contrast, directional ground shadow, external glow, copied heart/smile/ticks or a substituted easier target.

visibleOutcomes.good: A clean true transparent silhouette over light, gray and dark; no brown haze, opaque backing, detached debris, black dead spots, clipped edges or visible halo. Edges/highlights stay controlled at game size and enlarged through appear/idle/fade. The authorized rectangular crop retains all RGBA inside its bounds.
visibleOutcomes.reject: Python-painted repairs, alpha erasure or thresholding of retained pixels, per-frame/per-facing refits, visible matte/halo, edge shimmer unrelated to the original animation, food/rim clipping.

visibleOutcomes.good: All nine recipe/state clips remain 12 frames at 12fps with original order/loop flags, bob, appear and fade math, fixed complete 384x640 physical / 192x320 logical frame, [96,248] logical root, sourceScale2 and original 6x2 packing. N/E/W share S camera-facing pixels/rects. Above-customer evidence uses current native -172 attachment and full registered rendering; timer stays separate. Preference reads clearly above the customer and is not confused with other feedback.
visibleOutcomes.reject: Per-pose fitting, lost clip/facing/slot, altered timing or opacity endpoint, camera/Blender claims for flat art, overlap caused by changed registration, historical -90 placement presented as current runtime.

requiredReviewEvidence: An immutable hash-bound packet includes native 2D source/recipe, frozen raw target/provenance, compact source registration, original-publisher/contract dependencies, three canonical food dependencies, atlases, frames, preview outputs and technical validation. Account for and visibly inspect all 108 actual frames in compact labeled contact sheets, at logical scale and enlarged. Inspect representative and boundary frames on light, gray and dark. Do not replace frame inspection with a massive unreadable grid.

Motion/playback evidence for each recipe across appear, looped idle and fade verifies bob, joint food/balloon scale/alpha, timing, endpoints and loop behavior. A contact sheet alone does not prove playback.

Show three composed recipe balloons at 82 logical balloon /40 logical food width, empty normalized balloon, and source-to-candidate fixed-target comparisons. Show clean alpha at enlarged view and game scale.

Show actual current above-customer context using current native full-frame placement and -172 attachment, with separate runtime timer where applicable. If a deterministic code-equivalent context composite is also supplied, label it accurately; historical catalog -90 context must be explicitly historical.

Bind exact submitted packet SHA256 and list every inspected file/hash in round review. Missing source/replay/frame/motion/alias/context evidence yields needs_evidence rather than approval. Approval requires visible improvement plus passing contract; no numeric threshold substitutes for inspection.
